entry.title: 5 of the biggest retail horror stories of 2026
entry.summary: From Nike’s turnaround setbacks to Chip Wilson’s battle with Lululemon, the spookiest sights weren’t found on retailers’ shelves this year.

entry.title: Walmart’s chief marketer breaks down retailer’s Muppet-fueled holiday campaign
entry.summary: For a unified push during the holidays, the retailer is recreating the world of “The Muppet Christmas Carol” and extending its “Who Knew?” brand platform.

entry.title: These 3 department stores need a good holiday
entry.summary: Kohl’s, J.C. Penney and — once again— Saks Fifth Avenue have a lot riding on this year’s shopping season.

entry.title: Target overhauls Threshold home goods brand
entry.summary: The $3 billion private label has improved quality, merchandising and, in some cases, prices, and added more than 800 items to the assortment.

entry.title: Aritzia banks on store openings, product expansions to double revenue in 5 years
entry.summary: The company plans to open as many as 14 U.S. stores a year and expand into bags, beauty and shoes on its path to becoming “world famous.”

entry.title: Etsy CEO addresses friction of AI vs. human creativity
entry.summary: The e-commerce marketplace saw active buyers in Q3 grow for the first time in two years and is utilizing AI to improve product recommendations.

entry.title: Jos. A. Bank puts customer experience at the center of new store concept
entry.summary: The menswear retailer’s new space, which was developed using customer insights, features an area for consultations, fittings and personalized service.

entry.title: Could this running brand rescue Vans owner VF Corp?
entry.summary: The Altra footwear brand’s revenue grew 40% in Q2 and is on pace to offset ongoing declines at the company’s faltering skater brand.

entry.title: Hasbro names third Wizards of the Coast president in under 5 years
entry.summary: Dan Ayoub, who now leads Wizards and Hasbro Digital Games, has been playing D&D with the same group of friends since he was 10 years old.

entry.title: Sephora casts Seth Rogen for holiday ads targeted at gift-givers
entry.summary: “The Studio” star plays a clueless shopper in a campaign aimed at consumers who aren’t in-the-know about beauty but are seeking thoughtful presents.
